## Decision flowchart

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  A[Start] --> B{Have phased reads /<br/>haplotype calls?}
  B -->|No| C[Use SNP dosage]
  B -->|Yes| D{Population structure?<br/>Many close relatives?}
  D -->|Yes| E[Microhaplotypes:<br/>more information per locus]
  D -->|No| F[SNP usually adequate]
```
